lines.text: In a paragraph with a sum Pni=1 xi and an integral R10 f the lines are spaced
more widely, since the limits sit beside the operators here. A limit such as
limn!1 an and a fraction a+b c in the text do the same, as do Pmk=0 1 k+1 and
Rba g, which every typesetting system must place with care. More words follow
so that the paragraph runs over several lines and shows the spacing.
A second paragraph with 12 and Pni=1 i2 and limx!0 sin x x and also R10 e�x
and the plain x2 + y2 in a line. Then ordinary words to finish the paragraph,
long enough for several lines of text.
